name: Barbell Power Clean
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, bend your hips and knees with a flat back, and grip just outside your shins.
Push through your feet to lift the bar closely past your knees, then extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively at your thighs.
Pull rapidly under the rising bar into a quarter squat while whipping your elbows forward to catch it across your front shoulders.
Stand fully tall to finish the clean, then lower the bar smoothly back to your thighs and the floor.
tips: Keep the bar sweeping close to your body throughout the pull and turnover.
Keep your arms straight until your hips reach full extension.
